reason: An OCR plugin that reads local images, sends them to configured OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible vision APIs, and returns recognized text with confidence scores and bounding boxes.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 兼容视觉 API 识别本地图片中的文字，并返回置信度与文本框坐标。
summaries.en: Recognizes text in local images through configured OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible vision APIs and returns confidence scores with bounding-box coordinates.

capabilities: Reads PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP images from absolute or workspace-relative paths
Sends image data to configured OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible vision APIs
Stores API configuration including an API key in local settings
Invokes the local curl process for HTTP requests
Provides OCR text, confidence values, and pixel or percentage bounding boxes
